## Task 1 · Settings for three videos (3 marks)

A studio needs three videos of its game *Desert Kite*:

- a wide store trailer of 30 s, in Full HD, that plays on every phone;
- a tall clip of 20 s for phones held upright;
- a copy of the 60 fps capture for later editing.

a) Write the resolution, the frame rate, the codec and the container of
each video. (2 marks)

{{< answer-space lines=4 >}}

b) The tall clip is exported at 2 Mbit/s, and the fast kite race looks
blocky. What do you change, and what happens to the file size? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}
